name: card
behavior: Static grouping container; no APG pattern (generic group semantics — interactive/selectable cards are a separate component, cf. Salt InteractableCard)

parts.note: grid: title/description stack with trailing action-slot column
trailing header slot for a button/menu; hosts other components, adds no recipe of its own
divider above footer is optional (border-subtle top rule)

anatomyNotes: Padding lives on root as inset-container; shadcn applies it per-section and Salt via Card*Section subcomponents — a RECIPE difference, same anatomy. Elevation expression (shadow vs border) follows the theme's elevation-strategy.
